explication: Ever Gauzy is a business-management platform spanning ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS, project work, and employee time/activity tracking. The main user workflow is through the authenticated web application: users enter the application, navigate business features, and use the platform’s API; the README also describes local desktop and server deployments. Desktop timer clients submit timesheets, activity, and screenshots to the API. The README documents broader feature areas than the sampled source verifies, so those are represented as capability areas without invented internal call chains.
